translations.web: Lay hands hastily on no one. Don’t be a participant in other people’s sins. Keep yourself pure.
translations.bsb: Do not be too quick in the laying on of hands and thereby share in the sins of others. Keep yourself pure.
translations.kjv: Lay ➔ hands suddenly on no man, neither be partaker of other men's sins: keep thyself pure.
translations.asv: Lay hands hastily on no man, neither be partaker of other men's sins: keep thyself pure.
